home.about_text: Northpoint Heating & Air is a family-run heating and cooling company in Charlotte. We repair, replace and look after air conditioners, furnaces and heat pumps for homes across the area.
home.area_text: We serve homes in Charlotte, Matthews, Mint Hill, Huntersville, Concord, Pineville and Indian Trail.

faq.q: What happens on an AC repair visit?
faq.a: We check the full system, test refrigerant and electrical parts, and give a clear price before any work. Many faults are fixed on the first visit when we can.

faq.q: What do you check on a heating repair?
faq.a: We check burners, igniters, blowers, thermostats and safety parts, then clean up after the job. The goal is steady, even heat.

faq.q: What is included with a new AC or furnace?
faq.a: We do a load check of the home, remove the old unit, then start up the new system and walk you through it. Estimates on new systems are free.

faq.q: How do I know if I need a new system?
faq.a: Signs include a system over 15 years old, repairs every season, and bills going up. The business answers questions about your home on the phone.
We offer a 1-year labor warranty. The business answers questions about your repair on the phone.

home.cta_text: Tell us what your system is doing and we will plan a visit.

service_pages.lead: Air conditioners that stop cooling, found and fixed on the first visit when we can.
service_pages.what: Repair for home air conditioners that stop cooling. We check the system, find the fault and fix it on the first visit when we can, with a clear price first.
signs: The system turns on and off over and over
includes: A clear price before any work

faq.q: What are signs I need AC repair?
faq.a: Warm air from the vents, water around the indoor unit, or a system that turns on and off over and over can mean it needs a check.
We do a full system check with refrigerant and electrical tests, then give a clear price before any work.

service_pages.lead: Furnaces and heat pumps brought back to steady, even heat.
service_pages.what: Repair for home furnaces and heat pumps that lose heat or heat unevenly. We test the parts and safety controls and work toward steady, even heat.

faq.q: What are signs I need heating repair?
faq.a: No heat or uneven heat, a burning smell, or loud bangs when it starts can mean it needs a check.
We check burners, igniters, blowers, thermostats and safety parts, then clean up after the job.

service_pages.lead: A new system sized for your home, with a written estimate first.
service_pages.what: Installation of a new AC and furnace sized for your home. We start with a load check and a written estimate, then remove the old unit and walk you through the new one.
includes: A load check of the home

faq.q: How do I know I need a new system?
faq.a: A system over 15 years old, repairs every season, or bills going up can mean it is time to talk about replacement.
We do a load check of the home, remove the old unit, then start up the new one and walk you through it.
